units.context: estimated tokens via actual Core counter; no claim of exact model tokens
units.latency: milliseconds; median 3 untraced ContextManager runs; separate traced allocation run
units.allocation: traced peak bytes during prepare only; not total process RSS/VRAM

ranking.precision_returned: hits / returned; null if no returns
ranking.recall_at_k: hits / gold; null if no gold
ranking.scope_leaks: count of selected IDs from different subject or WORKSPACE
ranking.forbidden_hits: count of selected IDs explicitly forbidden by fixture
ranking.resolution_correct: exact match with gold resolution; ambiguous requires CLARIFY
ranking.abstention_correct: empty ranking for empty-gold case; null otherwise

futureStateMetrics.correction: corrected active record; old superseded; lineage retained
futureStateMetrics.deletion: deleted/tombstoned canonical identity is not returned by lexical, semantic or capsule/cache
futureStateMetrics.no_resurrection: repeat deletion eligibility check after rebuild/reopen
futureStateMetrics.confidence: similarity/repetition must not act as truth confidence; source classes preserved

unknown: null + explicit reason; never zero/false/pass substituted for unmeasured capability
productQuality: NOT_IMPLEMENTED in M0; oracle self-check is not quality
thresholds: MEM1-OD-07 remains OPEN for M8; no arbitrary quality/performance cutoff
localModels: M0 not normatively required; no scripted adapter presented as real local model
tacReference: §19 arithmetic oracle only; no memory category/split wired into product
